question: Can the ONE existing tokenless NativeCumulativeLearner persistently compile source-grounded multi-hypothesis causal algebraic representations that predict new held intervention consequences its existing degree model abstains upon, while preserving all preceding native knowledge and passing cold continuation?
hypothesis: An opt-in source-derived native numerical ANF hypothesis version space (max three active terms among 16 four-input Boolean monomials, 697 total possible) stored inside the existing NativeCumulativeLearner checkpoint improves held-out Brier by at least 0.025 vs its unmodified native degree readout across six fresh synthetic law families and remains exactly equivalent to an independently fitted conventional full 697-rule Bayesian posterior over identical evidence. It retains original source and invalidates stale compiled views on continuation.
predecessors: CKAD25-S PR #1241, native sparse repair negative; CKAD25-T PR #1244, certification tied ungated; CKAD25-U PR #1247, native propose tied fixed and only one of six families answered.
CKAD32 PR #1246, source-grounded causal tournaments and full Bayesian readout gave stronger held predictions than native; SCREEN_NO_GO, avoid duplicate selection experiment.
CKAD30 PR #1243 and CKAD31 PR #1245: sparse repair and identifiability guard inadequate on held composition.

scope.native_extension: one opt-in causal relation compile method and probability readout inside same existing model; no rival learner, no owner controller, scheduler or agent, no unqualified source mode

generator.split: For each seed and law produce SHA-specified shuffled 16 unique 3-context-bit+action intervention assignments. Exactly first 12 consequences revealed through NativeCumulativeLearner.observe in two immutable packets of 8 and 4, other 4 held never passed to model. No chosen action can inspect future outcomes. Each seed uses ONE cumulative learner with six existing distinct slots 1..6 and the original native source checkpoint in slot0. 3 seeds × 6 laws × 12 = 216 new source-free training interventions; 3×6×4=72 held novel test outcomes.
generator.family_scope: Six explicit finite formula classes known to evaluator; model receives no family labels but DOES have a supplied three-term ANF hypothesis class. Even positive is bounded algebraic interpolation not novel general intelligence or unfamiliar grammar discovery.
generator.source: procedurally generated, public synthetic deterministic do/outcome fixture, no original protected CausalGym or real-world source calls

native_change.module: NativeCausalRelationPosterior, source-pinned 697 uniformly weighted ≤3-term ANF coefficient hypotheses inferred only from native witnessed records; numeric coefficient vectors, no operator labels, no token/transformer, restore consistency must re-fit exact source evidence
native_change.learner: Opt-in compile_causal_relations(slot) stores compiled native relation weights in unchanged NativeCumulativeLearner's own checkpoint (new v6 schema), predict_causal_probability gives (numerator, denominator) or None, and observe on compiled slot invalidates stale compilation. All old v1-v5 checkpoint encodings remain exact.
native_change.capacity: 3 context bits + binary action only in first research candidate; 16 binary features and at most 697 possible weight vectors, at most 16 active slots. Existing owner/source and accepted model unchanged. No capacity expansion of accepted model.
native_change.strong_controls: Independent exhaustive exact 697-rule posterior with same revealed observations and uniform prior; original native degree (abstentions p=.5); original native sparse opt-in diagnostic (only if eligible); fully trained CART depth4, RF64, logistic ANF C1, fitted beta frequency, no-memory 0.5. Full exact Bayesian is a mechanism-equivalent baseline and candidate CANNOT claim superiority over it.
native_change.weights: Binary GF2 coefficient mask per hypothesis; posterior mean over survivors provides soft probability for held outcomes. No neural training and no spontaneous primitive-grammar invention.

frozen_design.pre_score_checks: Source view SHA/evidence and child committee Git blob fixed before primary; public-input only negative; fake/mutated checkpoint rejected; old cold checkpoint digest must match; no post-hoc scientific model selection
frozen_design.compute_budget: One frozen original synthetic scored cohort on GitHub-hosted Linux and Windows each, plus same-cohort deterministic byte replay. CPU only, pinned Python 3.12, numpy/scipy/sklearn exact already qualified deps, <=20m per OS. 216 new observations/72 held per test run, no originals.
frozen_design.scoring: Held Brier = mean (p-y)^2; native abstain p=.5, compiled native fraction used directly, conventional exact posterior same fraction; counts of confident 0/1, wrong; original source and prediction retention, byte-identical cold restore and continuation after adding four original-free source rows to one compiled slot for engineering negative; difference vs conventional strongest fitted control.

qualification.engineering_required: All old checkpoints exact byte restore, compiled state persists after cold restarts, source hash joined, forgery/corruption rejects, no source leakage, new observed data invalidates stale committee without disturbing other learned slots, Linux/Windows full final regression PASS.
qualification.signal: Mean held Brier improvement at least 0.025 versus original native degree, compiled Brier ≤ no-memory 0.25 -0.02, parity with independently evaluated exact 697-rule posterior to 1e-12 on every held predicted probability (not superiority), no more than 4 incorrect fully confident held bits, source retention and cold continuation all PASS, and compiled Brier ≤ best fitted CART/RF/logistic control +0.03. This is development signal only and never scientific_pass.
qualification.mixed: All custody/engineering invariants PASS but at least one performance threshold FAIL; DEVELOPMENT_MIXED_NO_GO.
qualification.negative: Source preservation/restore failure, corrupted checkpoint accepted, estimator uses protected data/hidden outcomes, or any confident wrong >4; engineering fail / development no-go as applicable.
qualification.invalid: Any source/seed/held drift, missing conventional exact control, cross-platform score mismatch, post-score source/code or threshold changes. Do not retune against held labels.

prohibited_after_primary_run: accepting scientific superiority based on exact-control parity
note: Distinct from CKAD32 action tournaments: this is the opt-in representation/checkpoint integration itself, directly conditioned on witnessed consequences. Native compiled weights are a conventional hypothesis class. Only independent original-source scientific testing could support claims of new intelligence.
